Alaska Conservation Society
Box 80192 College, Alaska 99701
July 6, 1972
Director
Bureau of Outdoor Recreation
US Department of the Interior
C Street Between 18th and 19th
Washington, D. C. 20240
Subject: Comments on Interior DES 72-62 RE: Draft Environmental Impact Statement: "Proposed Departmental Implementation of E. O. 11644 Pertaining to Off-Road Vehicles on the Public Lands".
Dear Sir:
The Alaska Conservation Society appreciates the spirit and philosophy behind E. O. 11644 establishing the basis for departmental control of off-road vehicle use on all of our public lands. Because of the vast proportion of Alaska's lands within the public domain, and because of the present and potential damage to the tundra and boreal forest ecosystems, and their wildlife resources, we are anxious to see that strong regulations are promulgated.
The Draft Environmental Impact Statement prepared by your Bureau applies to all Interior Agencies, Bureau of Outdoor Recreation, Bureau of Land Management, Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife, National Park Service and the Bureau of Reclamation. Because of the importance of these agencies in the management of Alaska's public lands, we offer the following comments for your review and consideration.
